title: Supplier reorder check
goal: Find what is low in stock for venture {venture} and write the reorder list with quantities and supplier links; buy nothing.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Stock at or below this number is low

steps.title: Read stock and write the reorder list
steps.brief: Read stock with shopify.inventory and/or etsy.inventory (whichever is connected; say which is not). Every item with quantity at or below {threshold} is low. Write outbox/supply/reorder-{venture}.md: a table of low items (title, sku or listing id, quantity now, suggested reorder quantity = the last 30 days of orders for it from shopify.orders / etsy.receipts, or "no order data"), and the supplier URL for each if one is in your memory or the product notes, else "supplier unknown". Do not place any order: purchasing is a separate request the Superintendent approves.
